name: Ulldemolins (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a black pale along the hoist, charged at the centre of the fly with a dark green millstone bearing a white eye.
history: The official flag of Ulldemolins is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, yellow, with a black pale of thickness 7/27 of the length at the hoist and the dark green millstone with a white eye of the arms; the council agreed to begin the adoption file on 28 January 2016, and the flag was approved on 6 July 2017 and published in the DOGC on 14 July 2017.

features.role: pale of 7/27 of the length along the hoist
millstone with a white eye and black iris
